info.title: Messaging Me API
info.description: The public API of Messaging Me: contacts, sends, conversations, templates and outgoing webhooks. Errors are { error, code }; code is absent only on generic failures.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes the call safe to replay: the same key returns the first result. Required unless the body has idempotencyKey.

variables.description: Values for this recipient only, never written on the record: the {{name}} of an RCS message, or a template parameter of source variable.

params.description: Template parameters: positions run from 1 to N, with no gap and no repeat.

schema.description: One target, 1 to 50 recipients. A malformed recipient is skipped (see skipped in the response), it does not fail the send.

post.summary: A contact sent a message (WhatsApp or RCS).
post.description: Sent to every webhook endpoint subscribed to this type. Signed per Standard Webhooks.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: The event id (evt_…), stable across retries.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds; reject a timestamp more than 5 minutes away.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of id.timestamp.body>, keyed with the base64-decoded part of the secret after whsec_; during a rotation, two signatures separated by a space.

id.description: evt_ followed by 32 hex characters; stable across retries and replays. Also sent in webhook-id.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Anything else is retried for 24 hours.
